description: Qwen3.8 27B at Q8_0 quality with 256k context, served as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Pre-configured for 48 GB GPUs - deploy and go.
readme_intro: Qwen3.8 27B in Q8_0 quantization (near-lossless quality) with the full 256k-token context window, quantized KV cache, and Flash Attention. Sized for a single 48 GB GPU. Each worker serves one request at a time; RunPod scales workers out under load.
